selection.rationale: With no prior strategy-local optimization outcomes, this initial round distributes the 64-structure budget broadly across all five bcc_refractory compositions (NbTaVZr, NbTaVHfZr, NbTaVHfZrTi, Nb2TaVHfZrTi, NbTa2VHfZrTi), all five size tiers (3 in tier 4, 9 in tier 8, 24 in tier 16, 20 in tier 32, and 8 in tier 64), and all three perturbation modes (chemical disorder, substitutional ordering, and 2% bounded strain). Small-cell allocations (tier 4) are focused on quaternary NbTaVZr and kept modest to avoid symmetry-deduplication saturation and stoichiometric truncation of 5- and 6-component alloys, while medium-to-large supercells (tiers 16 and 32) receive the bulk of the budget to capture diverse multicomponent local chemical environments and off-equilibrium strained configurations.
